card.name: Slashes and decimals in combination doses
card.fires_on: The slash or decimal point inside paired strengths of combination products, such as 2 mg/0.5 mg or 100/25 mg. It also fires on 'with' after a booster-type drug name such as ritonavir.

modes.label: Slash between paired strengths
modes.description: The slash between two numbers in a combination dose, mostly for boosted protease inhibitors.

modes.label: Decimal point in second strength
modes.description: The point in the second number of a buprenorphine/naloxone strength pair.
modes.example: Clinicians should start with an initial dose of 2 mg/0<<.>>5 mg or 4 mg/1

modes.label: Linking word near ritonavir
modes.description: A linking word such as 'with' placed right before ritonavir.
